d: Greenland—a land known as the 'world's largest island,' the birthplace of the unique sport of 'kayaking,' home to the UNESCO-listed 'Ilulissat Icefjord,' a place where 'dog sledding' is a means of survival, and where the magical waves of the 'Northern Lights' can be witnessed up close in the sky. That is Greenland... There is so much about it that you simply must know. So, come along with us on a journey to Greenland—right here on Infinity Stream.
